name: mythopraxis
description: Stories, archetypes, and pressure tests for agents that need more than instructions.

interface.shortDescription: The stories agents carry under pressure.
interface.longDescription: Turn plain instructions into bounded narrative rehearsals, apply original character exemplars, and audit agent prompts for imbalance, sycophancy, overclaiming, and persona drift.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Mythopraxis to weave this instruction into a bounded narrative rehearsal, then apply it to the real task.
